description: Add or update a signed webhook endpoint (up to 5 per workspace on paid plans) to push post, draft, review, approval and account events to Slack, Zapier, Make or your own HTTPS server. When adding a new endpoint, the response includes its whsec_ signing secret once: tell the user to save it securely. Ask the user before adding or changing an endpoint.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

description.description: Optional note for your own list, up to 120 characters.

enabled.description: false pauses sending to this endpoint; true resumes it.

events.description: Which events to send: post.scheduled, post.rescheduled, post.published, post.failed, post.needs_check, post.cancelled, draft.created, draft.updated, review.submitted, approval.requested, approval.approved, approval.rejected, inbox.replied, account.needs_reconnect. Every event when left out.

id.description: An existing webhook id from webhooks_list to update. Leave out to add a new endpoint (up to 5 per workspace).

url.description: The public https:// address events are sent to, up to 2048 characters. Required when adding a new endpoint.

name: webhooks_save
title: Save a webhook endpoint
